quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #23
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 30

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look for other vehicles, then go if the intersection is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light tells drivers to slow down and go through the intersection carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Ramps and bridges freeze before regular roads.
questions.explanation: Ramps and bridges are exposed to cold air on all sides, so they freeze faster than regular roads. Drive carefully when crossing bridges in freezing temperatures.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Require your vehicle to have a tune-up sooner.
Start grass fires on country roads.

questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes toxic gases from the engine. Fumes from a leaky exhaust system are dangerous and can cause drowsiness while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are driving on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: When visibility is reduced, what should you do first?

options.text: Look for road edge markings to guide you.

questions.explanation: Reducing your speed is your first step when visibility is poor or road conditions are dangerous.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line in the middle. What does this tell you?

options.text: You are on a two-way road.
You are on a one-way road.
You must stay to the left of the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are on a two-way road.
questions.explanation: Yellow centerlines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you can pass slower traffic when it is safe.

questions.question: Which factor does NOT affect how far it takes to stop your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on your speed and road conditions.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into a driveway, enter or exit a highway, or make a U-turn where permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What is the safest way to back up your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn right before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
Check your rearview mirrors to see what is behind you.
Turn up the car radio before backing up to get attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: Backing up is risky because drivers cannot see clearly behind their vehicles. Before backing up, walk around the back of your vehicle to check for children and small objects.

questions.question: What colors are used for warning signs about upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
White letters or symbols on a blue background
White letters or symbols on a green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: Before turning left, you should:

options.text: Swing to the right side of your lane.
Wait until oncoming traffic has a red light.

questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic light, you must let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles go first.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in business zones?
questions.explanation: Unless a sign says otherwise, the speed limit in business, residential, or school areas is 25 mph.

questions.question: Signs that require drivers to follow an instruction are called:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs require drivers to obey them. Breaking this rule can result in a penalty.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show directions and distances.
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show directions and distances to places. They are helpful when driving in new areas.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a circular red light.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a circular red light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a circular red light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: Is it safe to use cruise control on snowy or icy roads if you reduce your speed?
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snowy or icy roads. Your tires may slip and you will lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: Which recommendation does NOT help with safe night driving?

options.text: Know that tinted windows make it harder to see in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look directly into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look directly into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Looking into oncoming headlights makes your eye pupils shrink. When the vehicle passes, your pupils need time to adjust back to the darker light. During this adjustment time, you cannot see well.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, drivers should:

options.text: Drive faster to reach their destination sooner.
Stay closer to the car ahead.
Stay farther behind the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther behind the car ahead.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the distance between your vehicle and the car ahead of you.

questions.question: The traffic light turns from green to yellow as you approach an intersection. You should:

options.text: Treat it like a warning and keep going through.
Stop before entering the intersection, unless stopping is unsafe.
Speed up to get through before the light turns red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection, unless stopping is unsafe.
questions.explanation: At a yellow light, slow down and stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are too close to stop safely, drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system is dangerous because it can cause:
questions.explanation: The exhaust system pushes harmful fumes out of your vehicle and keeps them out of the passenger area. Fix any leaks in your exhaust system right away to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning.

questions.question: When you see a solid green arrow on a traffic signal, you:

options.text: Should move into the lane that matches the arrow direction.
Should slow down and stop if it is safe.
May turn in the direction of the arrow after letting traffic and pedestrians in the intersection go first.
May drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn in the direction of the arrow after letting traffic and pedestrians in the intersection go first.
questions.explanation: A green arrow tells you that you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane. Always let vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection pass first.

questions.question: Your vehicle is in an accident and is blocking traffic. You should:

options.text: Move your vehicle to the side of the road if you can.
Wait for police before moving your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle to the side of the road if you can.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your vehicle off the road if possible. Stay at the scene and give your information to the other driver.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning left.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks side by side:

options.text: It is always safe to cross after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing the tracks.
After one train passes, check the other track for another train before crossing.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check the other track for another train before crossing.
questions.explanation: When there are two railroad tracks, watch for a second train on the other track after the first one passes. Do not cross until you are sure no train is coming from any direction.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are pointed downward. This hand signal means the driver will:
questions.explanation: When a driver points their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, you should:

options.text: Turn your wheels toward the right.
Turn your wheels toward the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels toward the right.
questions.explanation: When parking on a downhill slope, turn your wheels sharply toward the side of the road. If your vehicle rolls, it will roll toward the side and away from traffic.

questions.question: What color are signs for public recreation areas?
questions.explanation: Brown signs mark areas of cultural and historical interest, and public recreation areas. They are useful when you are driving in an unfamiliar place.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. You should get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed
Speed up to avoid traffic buildup
Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic in

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if it is safe, to let traffic in
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle
The bicycle always has the right-of-way
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing bicycles because cyclists may suddenly swerve to avoid objects in the road. Always drive carefully around bicyclists.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two one-way roadways with a median or divider between them. Stay in the right lane.
